strings.dgl.title: Diagrams
strings.dgl.intro: A flow is maintained by fixing its shape, not its wording — the confidence and duplicate tools for prose cannot see any of the problems flagged below.
strings.dgl.filter: filter by title, summary, domain or tag…
strings.dgl.newBody: Creates a start→end skeleton and opens the canvas, where the flow gets built step by step.
strings.dgl.documentedWhy: steps carrying a note explaining why they are that way
strings.dgl.emptyHint: A diagram documents one routine end to end, so each step can be pointed at from the notes that explain it. Create one here, or call the diagram() tool.
strings.dg.issueWhy.empty: The diagram has no steps at all.
strings.dg.issueWhy.no_start: No step is marked as the start, so there is no entry point to read the flow from.
strings.dg.issueWhy.many_starts: More than one step claims to be the start; a routine has one entry point.
strings.dg.issueWhy.unreachable: Nothing leads to these steps from the start — usually a connection that was never drawn.
strings.dg.issueWhy.dead_end: The flow stops at these steps without them being marked as an end.
strings.dg.issueWhy.unlabeled_branch: These steps fork without saying which condition takes which arrow.
strings.dg.issueWhy.no_end: No step is marked as the end, so the flow never states where it finishes.
